ayuda_menu_abrir: Opens the window to grow climbing plants.
ayuda_menu_escena: Creates a new scene, ready to press Grow.
confirmar_escena_nueva: The scene has unsaved changes. Do you want to save them before opening the test scene?
aviso_plugin_no_cargado: Trepadora: Maya could not load the plug-in {ruta}. Check the messages above in the Script Editor.
ayuda_usar_seleccion: Select in the viewport the meshes the plant will climb (walls, ground, columns…) and press here.
superficie_ninguna: None yet: select one or more meshes and press Use selection.
superficie_lista: Surface ready ({n} meshes). Now mark where the plant starts, or press Grow.
falta_superficie: First select one or more meshes (for example, a wall and the ground) and press Use selection in step 1.
ayuda_zonas: Put a box (or any mesh) in front of a window or a door, select it and press Use selection: the plant goes around it and does not grow inside. If there are several, select them all at once. Afterwards you can hide them with H.
ayuda_quitar_zonas: The plant can grow everywhere again.
zona_lista: The plant will not grow inside this zone. You can hide it with H: the plant still avoids it.
zonas_listas: The plant will not grow inside these {n} zones. You can hide them with H: the plant still avoids them.
falta_zona: Select the box or the meshes that cover the window or the door and press Use selection in No-grow zones.
ayuda_clic_visor: Turn on this tool and click on the surface where you want each plant to start. Press Q to go back to selecting.
origen_ninguno: No origins: the plant will start at the bottom of the surface.
origen_ninguno_guia: No origins: the plant will start at the beginning of the guide curve.
clic_instrucciones: Click on the surface where each plant starts. When you are done, press Q or press Click in viewport again.
origen_colocado: Origin placed. You can add more or press Grow.
origen_fuera: That click is not on the chosen surface. Click right on top of one of its meshes.
ayuda_guia_curva: Draw a curve on the wall or close to it (Create > Curve Tools > EP Curve Tool), select it and press Use selection: the plant grows along it, from the first point you drew to the last. To flip it: Curves > Reverse Direction.
guia_lista: The plant will follow the curve, from the first point to the last. If there are no origins, it starts at its beginning.
guias_listas: The plant will follow {n} curves, each from its first point to its last. If there are no origins, a plant starts at the beginning of each one.
falta_guia: Select a curve (draw it with Create > Curve Tools > EP Curve Tool) and press Use selection in Guide curve.
ayuda_tipo_tallo: Woody, gnarled, green and thin, or reddish like Virginia creeper.
ayuda_forma_hoja: The shape of the leaves. To use a leaf you modelled yourself, go to Advanced settings > Leaves.
ayuda_pasos: How much the plant grows (growth steps). With more steps it gets bigger, until it fills the space it has; then it stops by itself.
ayuda_densidad: How many leaves grow along the stems. At 0 only the stems are left.
ayuda_grosor: Multiplies the thickness of the stems. You see it when you press Create mesh.
ayuda_semilla: The same settings and the same seed always give the same plant. Change the number to see another variant.
ayuda_escala: Size of the growth steps, the leaves and the stems compared with the scene. 1 = automatic; raise it if the leaves come out tiny and lower it if they come out huge.
ayuda_adherencia: How much it sticks to the surface (0 to 1).
ayuda_gravedad: How much it hangs when it loses support. Above 0.5, curtains fall down the walls.
ayuda_luz: Tendency to climb up the walls.
ayuda_prob_rama: Chance that a new branch sprouts at each step.
ayuda_generaciones_max: How many times branches can branch again (branches of branches).
ayuda_longitud_max: Maximum length of the main stem, in steps. Child branches are shorter.
ayuda_brotes_basales: Extra stems that start from each origin.
ayuda_prob_colgar: Chance that a stem drops down hanging when it passes the edge of a wall or a ledge.
ayuda_guia: How closely the stems follow the guide curve from step 2 (0 = not at all). Without a guide curve it does nothing.
ayuda_tamano: Size of the leaves (1 = automatic for the scene).
ayuda_variacion: Difference in size between leaves (0 = all the same).
ayuda_caida: How much the tips of the leaves hang down.
ayuda_despegue: How far the leaves stand off the wall (0 = flat against it).
ayuda_manchas: Groups the leaves into dense clumps with gaps between them (0 = even spread).
ayuda_bronce: How many leaves turn bronze, like ivy in winter.
ayuda_instancias: The leaves are copies of a few model leaves and the scene is much lighter. Turn it off to have all the leaves in a single mesh, for example to export it.
ayuda_hoja_propia: Use a leaf you modelled yourself: select it and press Use selection. Model it with its base at the origin, the tip towards +Y and the face towards +Z.
ayuda_quitar_hoja_propia: Goes back to the leaves of the chosen shape.
hoja_propia_lista: The leaves will be copies of {nombre}.
falta_hoja_propia: Select the mesh of your leaf and press Use selection.
ayuda_resolucion: Sides of the stem tubes: low is lighter and high looks rounder up close.
ayuda_raices: Small roots that hold the stems to the wall, like ivy's (0 = none). They only appear where the stem lies against a surface, not on hanging parts or at the tips.
ayuda_crecer: Grows the plant from scratch with these settings. It only draws lines, so it is quick. Esc stops it.
ayuda_crecer_mas: Makes the current plant bigger without starting over. If its branches stopped because of their length, it lengthens them.
ayuda_reiniciar: Deletes the lines to start again. The surface and the origins stay.
ayuda_recortar: Turn on this tool and click on a line of the preview: the branch is cut there, together with everything that sprouts beyond. Ctrl+Z brings it back. Press Q to go back to selecting.
recortar_instrucciones: Click on the branch you want to cut, right where you want to cut it. When you are done, press Q or press Prune branches again.
rama_recortada: Branch pruned (Ctrl+Z brings it back). Create mesh uses the pruned plant; if you press Grow again, it grows again without the cuts.
recortar_fuera: That click is not on any branch. Click right on top of a line of the preview.
recortar_sin_planta: Press Grow first: branches are pruned on the preview.
crecer_mas_maximo: The plant is already at its maximum size. If you want more, create the mesh and grow another plant next to it.
parada_espacio: The plant filled the space it had at step {pasos}: more Size will not make it bigger.
parada_largo: The branches reached their maximum length at step {pasos}: Grow more lengthens them.
parada_superficie: The branches ran out of surface to hold on to at step {pasos}.
crecer_mas_espacio: The plant has already filled the space it has. To cover more, add another mesh in step 1 or put an origin in a free area; for more leaves, raise Leaf density.
crecer_mas_superficie: The branches no longer find a surface to hold on to. Add another mesh in step 1 or put an origin in another area.
crecer_mas_largo_maximo: The branches are already at their maximum length. For more plant, add another origin, or create the mesh and grow another plant next to it.
crecer_mas_limite: The plant has reached the safety limit. Create the mesh and grow another plant next to it.
ayuda_crear_malla: Creates the stems with thickness, the leaves and the materials. This is the heavy step: do it when you like the shape.
pie_sin_crecer: Press Grow to see the shape.
pie_cambiado: You changed settings: press Grow to see them.
confirmar_carga_alta: About {hojas} leaves will be made. Maya may take a while and the scene will be very heavy. Create the mesh anyway?
resultado_malla: Plant created: {hojas} leaves ({segundos} s). If you don't like it, Ctrl+Z undoes it.
malla_cancelada: Growth stopped: the mesh was not created.
detenido: Stopped with Esc: what has grown is kept.
limite_corto: The safety limit was reached: lower Size or Branching.
ayuda_preajustes: Starting points. Choosing one changes the settings, but does not delete what has already grown.
preajuste_de_planta: Copy the settings of the selected plant
preajuste_existe: There is already a preset called «{nombre}». Do you want to replace it?
preajuste_no_valido: That file is not a Trepadora preset ({error}).
preajuste_confirmar_borrar: Delete the preset «{nombre}»? This cannot be undone.
preajuste_aplicado: Preset «{nombre}». Press Grow to see it.
valores_por_defecto: Default values. Press Grow to see them.
ajustes_de_planta_cargados: Settings of the selected plant (seed {semilla}). Press Grow to repeat it.
sin_planta_seleccionada: Select a plant made with Trepadora (its group or any part of it).
ayuda_exportar: Saves the selected plant (or the last one created) as FBX, for Unity or Unreal, or as Alembic, for other programs. The leaves become one mesh and the textures are copied next to it, at the chosen resolution. The arrow offers light leaves for games: cards with transparency that weigh about twelve times less.
exportado_ligeras: Light leaves: {n} vertices. In Unity, turn on Alpha Clipping in the leaf material; in Unreal, set Blend Mode to Masked.
exportado_sin_ligeras: Custom leaves cannot be made light (their outline is not in the texture): they were exported in full.
exportar_filtro: FBX for game engines (*.fbx);;Alembic for other programs (*.abc)
exportar_vacia: The plant has no stems or leaves to export.
exportar_fallo: Could not write {ruta}. Check the Script Editor in case Maya says why.
exportado: Exported to {archivo}, with {n} textures in the folder {carpeta}.
exportado_sin_color: Could not create the color map for {juegos}: the rest was copied.
ayuda_menu_exportar: Saves the selected plant as FBX or Alembic, with its textures.
ayuda_menu_exportar_ligeras: Like Export, but each leaf is a card with transparency: about twelve times lighter.
falta_malla: Trepadora: select at least one mesh (and, if you like, locators to mark the origins).
resumen: Trepadora: {ramas} branches and {puntos} points in {pasos} steps (seed {semilla}).
limite: Trepadora: the safety limit of {limite} points was reached. Lower the steps or the branching chance.
cancelado: Trepadora: growth stopped. What was generated so far is kept.
sin_arnold: Trepadora: could not create the Arnold material ({error}). In the render, all the leaves will be the same green.
resumen_instancias: Trepadora: {hojas} leaves, instances of {modelos} model leaves.
resumen_malla: Trepadora: {hojas} leaves in a single mesh.
forma_desconocida: Trepadora: there is no leaf shape «{forma}» (there are: {opciones}). «hiedra» is used.
tallo_desconocido: Trepadora: there is no stem type «{tipo}» (there are: {opciones}). «lenoso» is used.
sin_hoja_propia: Trepadora: «{nombre}» is not a mesh in the scene. The leaves of the chosen shape are used.
hoja_propia_sin_instancias: Trepadora: the custom leaf only works with instances, so the leaves will be instances.
hoja_propia_eje: Trepadora: the leaf «{nombre}» does not go from the origin towards +Y; it is fitted to its height. For a good result, model it with its base at the origin, the tip towards +Y and the face towards +Z.
sin_instancias: Trepadora: could not create the instances ({error}). The leaves go in a single mesh.
ayuda_texturas: Size of the leaf and stem textures. 1K for class; 2K or 4K for close-up renders; 512 or 1K for games. Changing it also changes the plants already in the scene.
texturas_cambiadas: Textures at {resolucion}: {n} textures changed in the scene.
texturas_sin_cambios: Textures at {resolucion}. New plants will use them.
texturas_faltan: The {resolucion} textures are missing from the Trepadora folder: the {usada} ones are used.
texturas_reparadas: Trepadora: {n} textures in the scene pointed to another folder (another computer); they now use the ones from this installation.
sin_texturas: Trepadora: could not set the textures ({error}). The plant keeps its colors, without textures.
